notes.title: SECRET AGENT OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Secret Agent is now available on Steam!

[i]Descendant of ninja lineage, Mikage Jin infiltrates Touka Academy undercover to solve mysterious incidents. With AI partner Momoka, he deepens friendships until an accident exposes his true identity. Can he still complete his mission?[/h1][/i]
